method: Agent-authored semantic retrieval control: 24 independently written fictional queries, four per language. Canonical targets were selected by reading the local source corpus through loadSources, the same rule-source loader used by baseline.sources(), and checking each target's full text. No private ticket text or rule passage is reproduced. Queries were authored without reading data/intents.json, model benchmark smoke queries, retrieval outputs or scores, and were frozen before model evaluation. Each target names a directly relevant rule; other relevant sources may exist. This is a small synthetic control, not expert gold labels or accuracy on real support traffic. Language quality has not been reviewed by a human. Do not revise queries or targets in response to evaluation misses.

cases.query: Ехал один, с незнакомцем вообще не общался, а он подошёл и застрелил моего персонажа. Как называется нападение, у которого не было причины по сюжету?
cases.rationale: Unprovoked lethal attack without an in-character motive.

cases.query: Стрелок стоял за границей зелёной зоны и целился в меня, пока я оставался внутри. Он уверяет, что защита не действует, ведь сам он снаружи. Какой пункт это разбирает?
cases.rationale: Cross-boundary attack on a protected player inside a green zone.

cases.query: Можно настроить отдельную программу, чтобы она сама нажимала кнопку рыбалки всю ночь, пока меня нет за компьютером? Это не меняет файлы игры.
cases.rationale: Unattended button automation using external software.

cases.query: Хочу звать игроков через общий чат в свой неофициальный канал про эту игру. Ссылку не вставлю, только название и приглашение. Для таких объявлений есть ограничение?
cases.rationale: Promotion of an unofficial community without a clickable link.

cases.query: Someone wants to buy my in-game sports car but pay me by bank transfer outside the game. Is a trade like that covered even if we have only discussed it?
cases.rationale: Proposed exchange of virtual property for outside money.

cases.query: I have two characters on the same server. Could a friend hold the first character's cash and then pass it to my second character so they never trade directly?
cases.rationale: Moving assets between one's own characters through an intermediary.

cases.query: After our game argument, this player sent my home street name and said they would come there to hurt me. Which rule deals with using offline details to frighten a player?
cases.rationale: Offline intimidation using personal location information.

cases.query: My main character died during Family War at the abandoned port. May I log into my spare account and keep fighting in that same event?
cases.rationale: Rejoining a family event on an alternate account after death.

cases.query: Көшеде кетіп бара жатқанда бір жүргізуші көлігін әдейі маған қарай бұрып, бірнеше рет қағып кетті. Екеуміздің арамызда ойын ішіндегі жанжал болған жоқ. Бұл әрекет қалай аталады?
cases.rationale: Deliberate vehicle assault without an in-character reason.

cases.query: Ойыншы чатта менімен емес, анам мен әкемді кемсітіп сөйлесті. Туыстарыма айтылған мұндай сөздерге қай ереже қатысты?
cases.rationale: Chat insults directed at a player's relatives.

cases.query: Бір адам өзін жобаның қызметкерімін деп таныстырып, тексеріс үшін оған ойын ақшасын беруімді сұрады. Оның әкімші болып көрінуі туралы қай тармақтан оқи аламын?
cases.rationale: Impersonating project staff to obtain virtual assets.

cases.query: Family War кезінде дәрі қобдишасын тасаның артында қолдана бастадым. Анимация бітпей жүгіріп шықсам бола ма, әлде емделу аяқталғанша сол жерде қалуым керек пе?
cases.rationale: Whether healing must finish behind cover during Family War.

cases.query: Shikoyatga qo'shishdan oldin skrinshotning chetlarini kesib, ayrim yozuvlarini o'chirdim. Shunday o'zgartirilgan suratni dalil sifatida qabul qilishadimi?
cases.rationale: Complaint evidence whose image content has been cropped and altered.

cases.query: Oilalar urushi, ya'ni Family War maydoniga mototsiklda darvozadan kirib, keyin uni qoldirsam bo'ladimi? Yoki hududga boshidanoq piyoda kirish kerakmi?
cases.rationale: Entering the family battle area on a vehicle rather than on foot.

cases.query: Yashil zona ichida turganimda meni arqon bilan bog'lab, pulimni berishni talab qilishdi. U yerda odamni talashga oid qaysi band bor?
cases.rationale: Restraint and robbery of a player who is inside a green zone.

cases.query: O'yindagi akkauntimni o'zim butunlay o'chirib yuborgan edim, endi fikrimdan qaytdim. Eski qahramonlarimni qaytarish mumkinligi haqida qayerda yozilgan?
cases.rationale: Restoration question after intentionally deleting a game account.

cases.query: Le pagué con dinero del juego por un coche y desapareció sin entregármelo. No hubo dinero real. ¿Qué norma trata este engaño entre jugadores?
cases.rationale: Deceptive player trade involving only virtual currency.

cases.query: En la batalla por la furgoneta quiero tapar la cara de mi personaje con una máscara. ¿Está permitido llevarla durante ese evento?
cases.rationale: Wearing a face mask during the van battle.

cases.query: Vi en una conversación fuera del juego dónde se escondía otro personaje y usé ese dato para encontrarlo dentro de la historia. ¿Cómo se llama mezclar así lo que sé yo con lo que sabe mi personaje?
cases.rationale: Using knowledge from outside the fiction to guide a character.

cases.query: Cada vez que aparece mi personaje en su punto de reaparición, alguien que espera allí le dispara inmediatamente. ¿Qué término corresponde a atacar justo al reaparecer?
cases.rationale: Attacking a character at the moment and place of spawning.

cases.query: Na guerra de famílias, deixaram vários carros atravessados no acesso ao porto para ninguém conseguir entrar. Qual regra fala desse bloqueio com veículos?
cases.rationale: Vehicle barricade obstructing entry to the family battle location.

cases.query: Um jogador mantém o microfone aberto transmitindo músicas e ruído tão alto que ninguém consegue conversar. Há uma regra específica para esse uso do áudio?
cases.rationale: Disruptive music and noise broadcast through voice chat.

cases.query: Vou mudar de servidor e queria combinar uma troca para receber no novo servidor o valor dos bens que tenho no antigo. Isso é permitido mesmo sem envolver dinheiro de verdade?
cases.rationale: Arranging a transfer of virtual wealth across different servers.

cases.query: Morri durante a disputa por um negócio entre organizações. Sem usar seguro de vida, posso voltar ao mesmo confronto depois de reaparecer?
cases.rationale: Returning to a business battle after death, excluding the insurance exception.
